instrumentation: Synchronous callback after the existing loop writes fine-eroded, warped, material-weighted relative optical density into the reused Float32 density buffer, immediately before the first original light bake. Borrow only; do not mutate or retain the large arrays after callback.
sameReducer: Derive once from canonical precipitationFootprint by replacing only its volume-size parameter and scalar-density accessor. Inverse source guard must reconstruct canonical reducer body exactly. At runtime canonical macro result must be byte-identical to the same derived reducer with byte/255 accessor BEFORE comparing the F32 result.
units: Macro is R_UNORM8/255. Fine is actual stored Float32 sampleCloudDensity*materialExtinction(ice)/18. Reducer visits y<=2.5 km; require iceStart>2.5, so ice=0 there and materialExtinction/18=1. No rescale, refit, gain change or normalization of generated maps.
preserved: all original generator bakes and occupancy
output: result.json compact statistics and temporal hook/progress
hook.json preserved even if a later light bake fails
spatialStatistics: R support transition counts at exact encoded >0
base-height differences on positive union and bilinear halo
spatial total variation between normalized R distributions as diagnostic only; maps remain unnormalized
Pearson correlation and ratio distribution on shared-positive support
nonMutation: SHA256 borrowed full F32 and macro RGBA bytes immediately before and after reductions; never write either input. Record the hashes without serializing the volume.

budget.rssEnforcement: terminal getrusage gate, not RLIMIT_AS and not a live RSS limit

execution: Root executor only, one child process, no automatic restart. If source/anchor/macro equality/unit/budget/generation fails, preserve that terminal failure and stop; do not run another resolution or seed.
interpretation: Exploratory source diagnostic at 64/64, not product quality 256/128, not a native image, GPU parity, hydrometeor simulation or FPS prediction. Spatial differences are necessary information, not an artistic PASS. A nearly uniform attenuation does not justify a visual trial by itself.
